title: Cross-modulation coherence weighting failed to improve a fixed PPG respiratory-rate estimator in two clinical cohorts
abstract: Cross-modulation coherence weighting did not improve this fixed multitaper PPG respiratory-rate estimator: BIDMC gain -0.133 breaths/min (95% CI -0.512 to 0.246); independent CapnoBase gain -0.312 (-0.538 to -0.100). The registered label-free estimator weighted pooled intensity, amplitude and interval modulation spectra by their pairwise multitaper coherence. Analysis retained 53 ICU BIDMC records and42 independent perioperative CapnoBase records. Equal-record errors, paired record bootstrap, matched power-only control, phase-randomized control and sensitivity analyses do not support an accuracy benefit. Cohorts were previously examined; this is not untouched dataset-level confirmation. The finding limits this rule, not all respiratory phase information.
